events.title: Servius Tullius celebrates a triumph over the Etruscans
events.description: According to the Fasti Triumphales, Servius Tullius, by Roman tradition the sixth king of Rome, celebrated a triumph over the Etruscans, one of three he held. Early in his reign he had warred against Veii and the Etruscans.
events.html: According to the Fasti Triumphales, Servius Tullius, by Roman tradition the sixth king of Rome, celebrated a triumph over the Etruscans, one of three he held. Early in his reign he had warred against Veii and the Etruscans.

events.title: Alfonso VI of Castile takes Toledo
events.description: Alfonso VI entered Toledo after its Muslim ruler surrendered. The old Visigothic capital became a centre where Christian, Jewish and Muslim scholars translated Arabic learning into Latin.
events.html: Alfonso VI entered Toledo after its Muslim ruler surrendered. The old Visigothic capital became a centre where Christian, Jewish and Muslim scholars translated Arabic learning into Latin.

events.title: Prince Henry the Navigator becomes administrator of the Order of Christ
events.description: Prince Henry the Navigator was appointed administrator of the Order of Christ, the Portuguese successor to the Knights Templar, based at Tomar. He held the post for life, and the order's revenues helped to fund his voyages.
events.html: Prince Henry the Navigator was appointed administrator of the Order of Christ, the Portuguese successor to the Knights Templar, based at Tomar. He held the post for life, and the order's revenues helped to fund his voyages.

events.title: Charles V issues the Edict of Worms against Luther
events.description: The emperor declared Martin Luther an outlaw and banned his writings. Protected by Frederick the Wise at the Wartburg, Luther began translating the New Testament into German.
events.html: The emperor declared Martin Luther an outlaw and banned his writings. Protected by Frederick the Wise at the Wartburg, Luther began translating the New Testament into German.

events.title: Constitutional Convention opens in Philadelphia
events.description: Delegates reached a quorum at the Pennsylvania State House and chose George Washington to preside. Over the summer they drafted the US Constitution.
events.html: Delegates reached a quorum at the Pennsylvania State House and chose George Washington to preside. Over the summer they drafted the US Constitution.

events.title: Ralph Waldo Emerson is born in Boston
events.description: Emerson became the leading voice of Transcendentalism. Essays such as 'Self-Reliance' shaped American thought and influenced Thoreau and Whitman.
events.html: Emerson became the leading voice of Transcendentalism. Essays such as 'Self-Reliance' shaped American thought and influenced Thoreau and Whitman.

events.title: Kennedy commits America to landing on the Moon
events.description: Addressing Congress, President Kennedy called for a man to be landed on the Moon and returned safely before the decade was out. Apollo 11 met the goal in July 1969.
events.html: Addressing Congress, President Kennedy called for a man to be landed on the Moon and returned safely before the decade was out. Apollo 11 met the goal in July 1969.

events.title: Star Wars opens in American cinemas
events.description: George Lucas's space adventure opened in a few dozen cinemas and became the highest-grossing film to that date. It reshaped Hollywood around the blockbuster and merchandising.
